violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through 12 years, less than 4 feet 9 inches in height; cannot be properly secured by vehicle belt (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(6)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through 12 years, less than 4 feet 9 inches in height; cannot be properly secured by vehicle belt
violation_type.typical_finding: Children ages eight through twelve years of age who are  less than 4 feet, 9  inches in height are riding in the operations van/ general purpose vehicle without booster seats.

finding_variants.text: Children ages eight through twelve years of age who are  less than 4 feet, 9  inches in height are riding in the operations van/ general purpose vehicle without booster seats.
Duing review of transportation 2 out  of 5 children being transported was found to not have a booster seat required for children betwween 8 and 12 years old and less than 4'9 in height.
